title: Stainless Steel Cheese and Citrus Zester Grater w/Extra Sharp Blade - Perfect for Lemons, Parmesan, Garlic, Chocolate - Spice Up any Kitchen Dish in Seconds with Your Premium Hand Held Shredder
description:
About this item
ZESTER - Add extra flavor to your dish. This zester grater with handle comes with a razor-sharp blade that allows you to easily zest and grate lemons, cheese, ginger, fruits, spices, and vegetables.
LEMON ZESTER - Zest & grate all you want. Our lemon zester tool is made with strong 430 stainless steel that can withstand rusting and corrosion. Use these graters for kitchen for countless meal preps.
ZESTER GRATER - Comfortable, non-slip handle. This ginger grater comes with a soft rubber handle, which is designed to give you a better grip. Shred as many ingredients for your recipes without straining your hands.
ZESTER GRATER WITH HANDLE - Save space in your pantry. Compared to bulky box graters, our cheese grater stainless steel comes in a slim and flat design. Easily store in your shelves or hang it anywhere in your kitchen.
CITRUS ZESTER - A practical gift. Got a friend who loves to cook? Give them a tool that'll make their life easier! Our cheese grater handheld comes in a black box that includes a cleaning brush and protective cover.

reviews_5s:
I could not be happier with my Zester!!! The price is great and it is made of high quality materials. I love the fact that it is made by small family business and made in Italy. I did try for USA made to no avail. Will definitely look at other items from this business.Hands done the best little grater I've ever used! I'd give it ten stars. It does a great job with ginger root, hard cheeses, garlic and citrus peels. I hope this product stays around forever.This grater works great it’s strong and so easy to use very sharp came with a brush for cleaning and a cover so you won’t cut yourself while removing from drawer.
The handle is very nicely made comfortable in the hand.
I would like to have another one about half the length although this one fits great over a large bowl as its base while using.Wow! What an incredible zester! This zester made zesting limes for key lime pie super quick and easy. Whenever I zested with my old zester, I always ended up with a nicked and bleeding knuckle—plus it required a lot of time and effort. The little brush that comes with this zester made cleanup a breeze. The included cover made it safe to put in a drawer with other utensils, without worrying about reaching inside and getting cut. Thank you for this great product!This is my first lemon zester and I’m glad I chose this one. I like the easy grip handle and the cover and cleaning brush that comes with it. It works perfectly. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a great zester at a great price!I needed this item for a recipe I was making the next day. It arrived on time and I used it right away. It was everything I expected. It's stainless steel so there is no worry about rust. The handle is sturdy and comfortable. The grate surface is nice and sharp. It comes with a cover to help grating surface sharp. I would recommend this utensil to any of my friends who had a need for it. It would make a perfect gift for a "foodie".This zester is such great quality!!! I have had numerous zesters, this by far is the best!!!Great product, no complaints really. It zests lemons and limes perfectly which is exactly what I got it for—making confections. Looks like as displayed and comes with everything advertised.Wonderful grater! It’s stainless steal, and sharp so it comes with a nice protective sheath, and also a handy cleaning tool. :)A very nice grater, perfect. Quality and affordable. Nicer than anything I've seen in the store.
reviews_1s:
I hate writing bad reviews for products from small companies, but this one is downright dangerous in my opinion. I’ve used plenty of zesters in the past with no issue. This one not only doesn’t zest past the very surface, but most importantly, it doesn’t stay straight. It’s like it’s drunk - it slips in various directions without any seeming rhyme or reason. I think maybe it’s because the blades are positioned in a curved shape, or because the little blades themselves are curved, maybe? I’m not sure why.

I bought it because it had so many glowing reviews, which honestly really confuses me and makes me wonder if there’s something wrong with the one I got, or maybe there’s some weird trick to how to use this one. After using it, I went back and specifically looked at the bad reviews, and lo and behold, I’m not the only one with this experience.I bought this product primarily because it comes with a cover and the one I have does not have a blade cover and I have to be very careful. I found that the grater just didn't work nearly as well as the one I had. I threw out the grater but am trying to salvage the cover.The only thing this managed to zest was my finger. Seriously, the holes on this thing are too dull and/or not angled properly, so it gouges anything it touches. Be warned.It's horrible. It just shreds a lemon right down past the rind in the first pass. The blades are not sharp they are jagged. I wish I could return but I threw away the box. I will be donating this one to the goodwill.The grater was difficult to hold and grate a lemon without hitting your hand with the blade. The plastic shield to cover the blade was very difficult to put on. It took too much force to cut zest safely. It did look nice.Was excited to try this product. Went to use it tonight for the first time and the parts that stick out are flat as they can be against the grater. There's not even a hair of a lift. There's no way that this could cut anything. I actually ran my fingers up and down the product several times just hoping I could find a 'sharp' area to be able to get some use out of it. No luck.I have used many zesters before, and I’m glad because if this were my first one, I would think zesting a lemon is the most technical and dangerous thing. This slips off the lemon and shoots down on to your fingers and hand cutting you unless you push really hard and saw back and forth. I threw it away because I can’t return it anymore.Bought this zested because it had multiple good reviews and was Amazon choice. Opened it and the Handle came dirty out of the box and the label was rubbed off. I was like that’s ok as long as it works, went to zest a lemon and nothing no zest the blades are way to flush with the main part of the steel. Save your time and money and just buy a Microplane Zester.It would catch and shred anything I tried to grate adding the pith to dishes. Ended up returning for an oxoWhile very sharp.. it rips lemon and orange skins rather than grates. Handle is cumbersome to hold. I was so hoping to love it... but it doesn't work well for my use.
